repos_data.description: Self-hosted artifact registry and pull-through cache in one binary. 17 formats: Docker/OCI, Maven, npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Raw, RubyGems, Terraform, Ansible Galaxy, NuGet, Pub, Conan, CPAN, RPM, Debian/APT, Hugging Face. No database, about 15 MB RAM idle, supply-chain curation built in.
